description: The opened Guardian article reports an indoor protest in Takhar but gives no attendance count, and does not state whether the venue was open to the public. The >=50-person and public-gathering criteria cannot be assessed.

description: Three captured calls contain 15 submitted queries and 121 pooled visible headers, but most results were unrelated, historical, or outside the month. English and Dari local-outlet targets and selected weekly/provincial terms were used; not every province, sector, outlet archive, community source, or Pashto archive was searched. Search snippets were not coded as facts.
required_followup: Continue targeted native-language and province/sector discovery where accessible, seek independent contemporary reporting, and document remaining archive gaps. Do not infer no events from the present searches.
